game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Whispering Corridor Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the lantern keeper ahead. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the mine cart by solving code steps involving belt_count that move the lantern keeper forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the mine cart first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
